text:
anya: Heads up — quantized int8 bring-up for rdx-7b-long shows a reproducible divergence when we prepend a short system prompt after a long appended user context. Not a simple off-by-one; looks like index mapping drifts after kv_shrink + prefix prepend. :eyes:

devon: repro? any logs or minimal steps?

anya: Repro steps (short):
```
# start session, append ~12k tokens
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/sessions -d '{"model":"rdx-7b-long-int8","session_id":"s1"}'
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -d '{"session_id":"s1","inputs":"<large doc ~12k tokens>","stream":false}'
# now prepend a short system message
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/sessions/s1/prepend -d '{"text":"System: translate to french"}'
# generate again -> tokens shift, output meaning changes
```
Observed: in fp16 and int4 builds outputs match gold. int8 build gives semantically wrong completions (token substitution pattern every ~512 tokens).

samir: Got a short log from runtime that looks relevant:
```
[2026-03-10 03:12:44] kvcache: shrink triggered, old_index_base=24576 new_base=24064
[2026-03-10 03:12:44] rope: phase_multiplier=1.0007 applied for offset normalization
[2026-03-10 03:12:44] kvcache: mmap copy done, dst_offset=512 src_offset=0 len=23040
```
Pattern: after shrink, prepend uses base-relative mapping expecting modulo wrap, but int8 quant path uses a fast memcpy path that assumes contiguous absolute indices. Leads to stale KV entries being read for later positions.

devon: Could be the specialized int8 memcpy routine skipping the index normalization step. Can you run small repro that toggles the memcpy path? E.g. set ENV USE_SAFE_COPY=1 and rerun.

anya: I ran that — with USE_SAFE_COPY=1 the divergence disappears. With the fast path enabled divergence reproduces immediately. So it's not RoPE math itself but the index -> memory mapping.

samir: Nice find. Short-term mitigation: disable fast memcpy for builds with kv_shrink enabled (flagged in runtime). Long-term: make the fast path call normalize_index(base, idx) before memcopy. Also add a unit test for prepend+shrink on quantized backends.

devon: Can you open a tiny PR with test + safe guard? Tag me and @eng-releases. For the PR description include the minimal repro from above and CI toggle to run on int8 job. :thumbsup:

anya: Will do. I'll also push a small eval that computes token-level edit distance across fp16/int8 for the prepend-after-longcase. If edit distance > 3 for >25% samples we'll block the int8 rollout.

ci-bot: nightly-quant-int8 (rdx-7b-long) failed 1 test: prepend-shrink-alignment.test. See pipeline: https://ci.redwood.ai/jobs/8821

devon: Thanks. Moving to hotfix branch. Let's also add a short note in onboarding checklist: "run prepend-after-long-session tests on quantized builds".

anya: Agreed. Adding to checklist and filing a postmortem note once PR merges.

samir: Should we also audit KV eviction logic for other fast paths (burst copy, mmap swap)? I can take that next sprint.

devon: Yes please. Assign to you. Thanks team. :rocket:
